+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: 'G: run mail ids on the run output events (mail step 2, part G)'
+---
+A plan gap that blocks step 3 (Agents). SessionOutbox.stage(event:) makes the MailID of run mail, but the output events runMessage, runSettled, runProgress and elicitationRequested do not carry it. Agents must wait for the delivery of each child message by MailID (mailbox.md section 5, problem 15).
+
+1. SessionOutbox.post(event:) makes the MailID before the journal write, and gives it to the journal write and to stage.
+2. Each of the four output events has the origin `.mail([id])` of its run mail. Bind the origin explicitly in the journal chain.
+3. A coalesced progress event has the id of the queued mail that it replaces.
+4. An event that makes no mail (a stopped run in ignoredRuns, or a refused put after close) has no mail origin. Its doc says which origin it has.
+5. The doc of each of the four SessionEvent cases says that the origin holds the MailID of its run mail.
+6. Fixed-order tests with no clock.
+Push after the reviewer accepts it. #mail
\ No newline at end of file

Agents must wait for the delivery of each child message by MailID (mailbox.md section 5, problem 15, "Gap found at the start of step 3").

+6. Fixed-order tests with no clock:
+   - The origin id of a runMessage equals the id of the later mailDelivered and an id in answered.mailIds.
+   - The same for runSettled.
+   - A coalesced progress keeps the queued id.
+   - A stopped run gives no mail id.
+   - Also the order where mailDelivered comes before the runMessage output event, if that order can occur. Tell the reviewer if it can.
+
+Run the full suite one time, commit, and report. When the reviewer accepts it, push it, because Agents builds against Router main.
+
+#mail #mail-step-2
\ No newline at end of file
